// REQ: LANG-671 LANG-672 LANG-673 LANG-674
#version 330 core

layout (location = 0) in vec3 aPos;
uniform mat4 model;
uniform sampler2D tex;
out vec4 FragColor;

/* Lighting. */
float lambert(vec3 n, vec3 l) {
    return max(dot(normalize(n), normalize(l)), 0.0);
}

void main() {
    vec4 color = texture(tex, aPos.xy) * 1.5f;
    if (color.a < 0.1) discard;
    FragColor = mix(color, vec4(1.0), lambert(aPos, vec3(0, 1, 0)));
    gl_Position = model * vec4(aPos, 1.0);
}
